title: P758 Machinery Control Development Center, Philadelphia Navy Yard, PA
agency: DEPT OF DEFENSE > DEPT OF THE NAVY > NAVFAC > NAVFAC ATLANTIC CMD > NAVFAC MID-ATLANTIC > NAVFACSYSCOM MID-ATLANTIC
description: This project will construct a multi-story facility with a high-bay test laboratory, two low-bay test labs, and flexible-use light lab areas. Primary facilities include structural steel framing, concrete foundations and structural slab, elevated floor slabs, masonry and insulated metal panel exterior skin, built-up roofing system, HVAC, plumbing, and fire protection systems.
